mapper.update: update ${database.prefix.activity}hou_addon_activity_seckill_goods set seckill_num = seckill_num - #{param.goodsNum} where goods_id = #{param.goodsId} and seckill_id = #{param.seckillId}
mapper.select:
SELECT goods_upper_limit, seckill_price, goods_start_time, goods_end_time, seckill_num, goods_name, seckill_id, ( SELECT sum( seckill_num ) FROM ${database.prefix.activity}hou_addon_activity_seckill_goods WHERE now() BETWEEN goods_start_time AND goods_end_time AND seckill_goods_state = 1 AND common_id = #{param.commonId}) as seckillNums
FROM ${database.prefix.activity}hou_addon_activity_seckill_goods WHERE now() BETWEEN goods_start_time AND goods_end_time AND seckill_goods_state = 1 AND goods_id = #{param.goodsId}

SELECT a.goods_upper_limit AS goodsUpperLimit, a.seckill_id AS seckillId, a.seckill_price AS seckillPrice, a.goods_start_time AS goodsStartTime, a.goods_end_time AS goodsEndTime, a.goods_name AS goodsName, b.cancel_time AS cancelTime FROM ${database.prefix.activity}hou_addon_activity_seckill_goods a LEFT JOIN ${database.prefix.activity}hou_addon_activity_seckill_base b ON a.seckill_id = b.seckill_id WHERE now() BETWEEN a.goods_start_time AND a.goods_end_time AND a.seckill_goods_state = 1 AND a.goods_id = #{goodsId}
SELECT seckill_num FROM ${database.prefix.activity}hou_addon_activity_seckill_goods WHERE seckill_id = #{param.seckillId} and goods_id = #{param.goodsId}

SELECT seckill_price, goods_start_time, goods_end_time, goods_upper_limit, seckill_num FROM ${database.prefix.activity}hou_addon_activity_seckill_goods WHERE seckill_goods_state = 1 AND ( now() BETWEEN goods_start_time AND goods_end_time )
and goods_id = #{goodsId,jdbcType=INTEGER}

SELECT dg.common_id, dg.goods_id, gc.common_name, gc.common_price, gc.common_image, dg.seckill_price, gc.common_salenum, gc.common_promotion_tips, dg.goods_start_time, dg.goods_end_time, dg.seckill_num, dg.seckill_id, dg.goods_upper_limit, IF( isnull( `gc`.`common_evaluate` ), 0, `gc`.`common_evaluate` ) AS commonEvaluate, dg.seckill_goods_state, sb.shop_name, sb.supplier_shop_id AS shop_id FROM ${database.prefix.activity}hou_addon_activity_seckill_goods dg LEFT JOIN ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_common gc ON (gc.common_id = dg.common_id) LEFT JOIN ${database.prefix.business}hou_shop_base sb ON sb.supplier_shop_id = gc.shop_id WHERE gc.common_stock > 0 AND dg.seckill_goods_state = 1 AND sb.shop_status = 3 AND gc.common_state = 1 and gc.common_is_xian = 2 AND gc.common_verify = 1 and dg.seckill_num > 0 and dg.goods_start_time between #{param.goodsStartTime} and now()
and gc.shop_id = #{param.shopId}
and gc.goods_type != 3
and common_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{param.commonName },'%')
GROUP BY dg.common_id ORDER BY dg.goods_start_time desc

SELECT seckill_price as activityPrice, goods_start_time as startTime, goods_end_time as endTime FROM ${database.prefix.activity}hou_addon_activity_seckill_goods WHERE seckill_goods_state = 1 AND ( now() BETWEEN goods_start_time AND goods_end_time ) AND goods_id = #{goodsId,jdbcType=INTEGER} limit 1;

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT dg.common_id, dg.goods_id, gc.common_name, gc.common_price, gc.common_image, dg.seckill_price, gc.common_salenum, gc.common_promotion_tips, dg.goods_start_time, dg.goods_end_time, dg.seckill_num, dg.goods_upper_limit, IF ( isnull( `gc`.`common_evaluate` ), 0, `gc`.`common_evaluate` ) AS commonEvaluate, dg.seckill_goods_state, sb.shop_name, ROUND(( dg.goods_price - dg.seckill_price )/ dg.goods_price, 3 ) AS proportion, sb.supplier_shop_id AS shop_id FROM ${database.prefix.activity}hou_addon_activity_seckill_goods dg LEFT JOIN ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_common gc ON ( gc.common_id = dg.common_id ) LEFT JOIN ${database.prefix.business}hou_shop_base sb ON sb.supplier_shop_id = gc.shop_id WHERE gc.common_stock > 0 AND dg.seckill_goods_state IN ( 0, 1 ) AND sb.shop_status = 3 AND gc.common_state = 1 AND gc.common_verify = 1 AND gc.common_is_xian = 2 AND dg.seckill_num > 0
and gc.shop_id = #{param.shopId}
and gc.goods_type != 3
GROUP BY dg.common_id ) a where a.proportion>=0.3 ORDER BY proportion desc limit 20

SELECT goods_id FROM ( SELECT sum( order_goods_num ) AS goodsNum, goods_id FROM ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_goods WHERE order_goods_status NOT IN ( 1, 7 ) AND goods_return_status != 2 AND goods_refund_status != 2 AND promotion_id = 2 AND order_goods_time BETWEEN #{param.startDateTime} and #{param.endDateTime}
GROUP BY goods_id ORDER BY goodsNum DESC LIMIT 20 ) A

SELECT a.seckill_goods_id, a.common_id, a.goods_name, a.goods_price, a.seckill_price, a.goods_image, a.seckill_id, a.goods_upper_limit, a.seckill_num, a.goods_id, a.goods_start_time AS startDateTime, b.goods_spec AS specValueName, a.shop_id FROM ${database.prefix.activity}hou_addon_activity_seckill_goods a left join ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_base b on a.goods_id = b.goods_id where a.seckill_id =#{param.seckillId,jdbcType=INTEGER}
select count(1) from ${database.prefix.activity}hou_addon_activity_seckill_goods where seckill_id = #{seckillId} and goods_id = #{goodsId}

select gb.goods_id as goodsId, gb.goods_spec as specName, gb.goods_price as goodsPrice, gb.goods_stock as goodsStock, gc.common_name as commonName, gc.common_image as commonImage from ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_base gb left join ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_common gc on gc.common_id = gb.common_id where gb.common_id = #{commonId,jdbcType=INTEGER} order by gb.goods_id asc
